events.description:
Tropical Nomads lands in Amsterdam for the first time with psytrance legend Burn in Noise — followed by a special PGP afterparty.

🔥 Burn in Noise comes to Amsterdam! 🔥

One of the biggest and most respected names in the global psytrance scene, Burn in Noise 🇧🇷 has been dominating dancefloors worldwide with his explosive energy, powerful grooves and unmistakable sound — performing at some of the biggest festivals and parties across the globe. 🌍✨

For the first time ever, Tropical Nomads lands in Amsterdam 🇳🇱, joining forces with PGP – Psychedelic Grateful Punks to create a massive psychedelic gathering.

This special edition will take place at Toekomstmuziek, one of Amsterdam’s most iconic underground venues.

Expect a full psychedelic experience featuring international artists, immersive decoration, body painting, psychedelic shop, and a dancefloor filled with pure energy and connection. 🌀

The main event runs from 18:00 to 03:00, followed by an official afterparty hosted by Psychedelic Grateful Punks from 03:00 until 12:00.

That’s 18 hours of music, community and psychedelic celebration. 🌈

📅 Save the date — more details and full lineup coming soon.

📍 Venue: Toekomstmuziek – Amsterdam 🇳🇱
📅 29th May, 2026
🕕 Main Event: 18:00 – 03:00
🌅 Official Afterparty by PGP: 03:00 – 12:00
🎶 18 Hours of Music
🌍 International Psytrance Artists
🌀 Psychedelic Decoration by SHIVA SHAKTI
